title: AutonomyLevel
description: The role a person plays in the decision loop. 1: observe and propose; the person decides and executes. 2: execute after approval; the person confirms every step. 3: autonomous under supervision; the person watches reports and samples. 4: virtual agent business; the person sets frame and goals and is drawn in when the frame is exceeded. Levels apply per process, per action and per risk class. See docs/architecture/governance.md.
